info.scriptSrcText: property this, Xpos, Ypos, ploshState, Yvel, grav, Xvelglobal gXVel, gXOffset, gPaused, gPloshList, gPloshXon beginSprite  this = sprite(the currentSpriteNum)  Xpos = float(-1000)  Ypos = float(-1000)  Yvel = -2  ploshState = #NULL  this.locZ = 98  gPloshList.add(this)  grav = 0.80000000000000004  Xvel = 0  this.height = 30  this.width = 2  this.locH = Xpos  this.locV = Yposendon exitFrame  if gPaused = 0 then    case ploshState of      #NULL:      #PLOSH:        Yvel = Yvel + grav        Xpos = Xpos + gXVel + gXOffset + Xvel        Ypos = Ypos + Yvel        Xvel = Xvel * 0.97999999999999998        Yvel = Yvel * 0.94999999999999996        this.rotation = this.rotation * 0.90000000000000002        if this.width < 50 then          this.width = this.width + 4          this.height = this.height + 2        else        end if        if this.locV > 280 then          gPloshX = this.locH          ploshState = #NULL          gPloshList.add(this)          Xpos = -1000          Ypos = -1000          Xvel = 0          Yvel = 0          this.locH = Xpos          this.locV = Ypos          this.width = 2          this.height = 30        end if        this.locH = Xpos        this.locV = Ypos    end case  end ifend
